title: Identification of Optic Nerve-Related Biomarkers in Primary Open-Angle Glaucoma Based on Comprehensive Bioinformatics and Mendelian Randomization.
authors: Zhao, Sijie; Dai, Qing; Rao, Zixuan; Li, Juan; Wang, Aiqin; Gao, Ziqing; Fan, Yuchen
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过生物信息学和孟德尔随机化识别青光眼相关生物标志物，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: PURPOSE: Glaucoma is the primary cause of permanent vision loss worldwide. However, the pathogenesis of primary open-angle glaucoma (POAG), the main type of glaucoma, has not yet been completely understood. METHODS: In our study, the POAG cohorts were obtained from the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) database (GSE45570). Biomarkers with diagnostic utility for POAG were identified through combining differentially expressed analysis, enrichment analysis, machine learning algorithms, and receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis. The regulatory networks (including a competing endogenous RNA (ceRNA) regulatory network and a small molecule compounds-mRNA network) were created. In addition, the Mendelian randomization (MR) analysis was used to identify exposures causally associated with POAG. Finally, the expression of the biomarkers was validated via real-time quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR). RESULTS: The Gene Ontology (GO) items that the differentially expressed genes (DEGs) between POAG and control groups enriched were relevant to light stimulation and DNA methylation. A total of three light stimulation-related biomarkers (RAB8A, PRG3, and SMAD3) were identified, which had diagnostic value for POAG patients. Besides, the ceRNA regulatory network contained 88 nodes and 93 edges, and a small molecule compounds-mRNA network included 66 nodes and 76 edges. The MR results indicated a causal association between DNA methylation GrimAge acceleration and POAG. Additionally, the results of RT-qPCR revealed that the expression trend of RAB8A was consistent with that of GSE45570. CONCLUSIONS: Taken together, this study provides three light stimulation-related biomarkers (RAB8A, PRG3, and SMAD3) for the diagnosis of POAG, providing scientifically valuable insights for further studies of POAG. TRANSLATIONAL RELEVANCE: Discovering biomarkers that possess diagnostic significance for POAG has the potential to offer new insights into the pathogenesis of POAG and present novel objectives for clinical intervention.
abstract_zh: 目的：青光眼是全球永久性视力丧失的主要原因。然而，原发性开角型青光眼（POAG）作为青光眼的主要类型，其发病机制尚未完全阐明。方法：在本研究中，POAG队列数据来源于基因表达综合（GEO）数据库（GSE45570）。通过结合差异表达分析、富集分析、机器学习算法和受试者工作特征（ROC）分析，筛选出具有诊断价值的POAG生物标志物。构建了调控网络（包括竞争性内源RNA（ceRNA）调控网络和小分子化合物-mRNA网络）。此外，采用孟德尔随机化（MR）分析来识别与POAG存在因果关联的暴露因素。最后，通过实时定量聚合酶链反应（RT-qPCR）验证生物标志物的表达。结果：POAG组与对照组之间差异表达基因（DEGs）富集的基因本体（GO）条目与光刺激和DNA甲基化相关。共鉴定出三个光刺激相关生物标志物（RAB8A、PRG3和SMAD3），这些标志物对POAG患者具有诊断价值。此外，ceRNA调控网络包含88个节点和93条边，小分子化合物-mRNA网络包含66个节点和76条边。MR结果表明，DNA甲基化GrimAge加速与POAG之间存在因果关联。RT-qPCR结果进一步显示，RAB8A的表达趋势与GSE45570中的结果一致。结论：综上所述，本研究为POAG的诊断提供了三个光刺激相关生物标志物（RAB8A、PRG3和SMAD3），为POAG的进一步研究提供了具有科学价值的见解。转化相关性：发现对POAG具有诊断意义的生物标志物，有望为POAG的发病机制提供新见解，并为临床干预提供新靶点。
